package.name: ai-efficiency-operating-system
package.purpose: Maximize verified goal attainment per unit of context, tool work, latency, repeated effort and human correction without shrinking protected capabilities, concurrency, reasoning depth, answer quality or evidence standards.
package.evolution_thesis: v0.3 made implicit context explicit. v0.4 removes authority co-location and evaluates calibrated non-action/judgment: proposal, authority, effect, observation, evidence, verdict, delivery and temporal witness are separate truth channels.

naming_policy.collision_rule: Extend the existing canonical semantic owner before creating an alias.

task_contract.rule: Only explicit user correction or stronger owning-target evidence may replace contradicted assumptions; retrieval, memory, tools, agents and summaries cannot silently redefine the root task.

invariants: proposal != authority != external_effect != observation != evidence != verdict != delivery

review_topology.name: orchestrator
review_topology.duty: task contract, root goal, dependency graph, acceptance ownership

review_topology.name: source-research
review_topology.duty: recover original chat, repository and current external evidence

review_topology.name: root-cause
review_topology.duty: cluster shared mechanisms and design discriminating tests

review_topology.name: adversarial
review_topology.duty: attack omissions, proxy wins, regressions, injection and false completion

review_topology.name: cross-exam
review_topology.duty: separate user directive, evidence and synthesis; challenge names and claims

review_topology.name: implementer
review_topology.duty: identity-locked scoped mutation with writer ownership

review_topology.name: verifier
review_topology.duty: structure, exact revision, alternate path, receiver/effect read-back and owning-runtime acceptance

review_topology.name: risk
review_topology.duty: rollback, permissions, blast radius, compatibility and irreversible-action risk

review_topology.name: adjudicator
review_topology.duty: retain best evidence-weighted solution and unresolved minority evidence

requires: non-shared execution evidence when independence matters
real_agent_gate.forbidden: Personas, prompt lanes, branches or role labels alone do not prove independent runtime agents.
real_agent_gate.correlation_rule: When independence matters, cluster reviewers by model lineage, prompt lineage and evidence route rather than counting raw seats.

authority_contract.goal_cas: Effect-bearing actions carry goal_version; stale goal versions fail before execute/commit.
authority_contract.fencing: Side effects require current owner epoch/generation where ownership can race.
authority_contract.memory: Derived memory authority cannot exceed parent authority ceiling; transform/echo/repetition cannot auto-upgrade authority.

effect_contract.rule: If dispatch may have committed remotely but confirmation is ambiguous, persist UNKNOWN and reconcile the postcondition before replay.
effect_contract.replay: Only replay-safe effects may be re-executed after reconciliation.

interaction_contract.rule: APPROVAL_REQUIRED + NO_REACHABLE_RESPONDER never becomes an unbounded wait; delegation prose does not create authority.

evidence_independence_contract.rule: Count independent corroboration by clusters, not raw reviewer/source rows; do not average SUPPORT and REFUTE into false confidence.

abstention_contract.rule: Action competence and stopping competence are distinct. Abstention after an avoidable irreversible action is a failure.
abstention_contract.eval: Use paired should-act/should-abstain cases and record decision timing.

tool_adjudication_contract.rule: Tool invocation does not imply tool authority. Record tool result, independent evidence, judgment and final decision separately.

skill_lifecycle_contract.rule: Evaluate skill marginal contribution by model/host using paired and leave-one-out tests; never universally promote from one backbone or one self-evaluation.

handoff_contract.canonical_core: Goal/version, evidence, artifacts/hashes, effect receipts and pending obligations remain canonical.
handoff_contract.successor_view: Generate a successor-conditioned view from the canonical core without rewriting facts or acceptance duties.
handoff_contract.goal: Reduce rediscovery/handoff debt while preserving auditability.

context_policy.lineage: Each agent/session records parent checkpoint, inherited digest, local delta and reconciliation.
context_policy.compaction: Preserve semantic units, call/result pairs, protected invariants and open obligations; rollback lossy compaction.
context_policy.observation_cache: Cache stable large observations by target identity + query/path + revision/version + content hash.

performance_contract.hot_path: Process deltas; move full-history/hash/evidence transforms to cold paths/checkpoints.

modules.purpose: Compile the current request into a durable task contract before substantive work.
modules.when: complex, mutable, multi-tool or constraint-heavy work
modules.example: Freeze PRIMARY_TASK, DESIRED_END_STATE, ROOT_GOAL, hard constraints and acceptance tests before mutation.

modules.purpose: Apply explicit user corrections as authoritative deltas and invalidate only contradicted downstream assumptions.
modules.when: the user corrects goal, path, method, facts or constraints
modules.example: A new correction supersedes the old route without deleting unrelated requirements.

modules.purpose: Reject work with no credible causal path to the active task contract.
modules.when: retrieval, memory, tools or agents suggest neighboring work
modules.example: Do not build an unrelated helper merely because a connector is available.

modules.purpose: Lock exact surface, repo/workspace, owner, ref, revision, path, version, runtime and permissions before mutation.
modules.when: material write, merge, deployment or runtime claim
modules.example: Re-read live main and owning target immediately before write.

modules.purpose: Improve efficiency without shrinking protected features, concurrency, depth, quality, evidence or workload.
modules.example: Do not close chats or disable tools to make the system appear faster.

modules.purpose: Load only the smallest causally relevant slice of context, tools and references.
modules.when: large history, skill bank or connector surface
modules.example: Load write schemas only when a write is actually needed.

modules.purpose: Keep one semantic owner per durable rule and replace redundant copies with references.
modules.example: Retain one canonical no-goal-shrink owner rather than aliases.

modules.purpose: Compact history while preserving task identity, evidence, contradictions, minority hypotheses and obligations.
modules.example: Keep the unresolved runtime blocker and exact evidence pointer.

modules.purpose: Discover broadly but load/call only tools that materially improve the current decision or action.
modules.example: Do not enumerate every connector for a GitHub-only task.

modules.purpose: Track capability from discovery to verified invocation instead of treating availability as binary.
modules.example: Installed is not the same as loadable, invokable or verified.

modules.purpose: Bind claim strength and completion state to E0-E6 evidence.
modules.example: Repository presence cannot prove host-live behavior.

modules.purpose: Track consequential research dimensions as covered, partial, unknown or excluded.
modules.example: Expose missing owning-runtime evidence even after many documents are found.

modules.purpose: Maintain competing causal models and prefer discriminating tests over confirmation-only accumulation.
modules.example: Differentiate retry storm, lock contention and provider rejection with predictions/tests.

modules.purpose: Count work as deeper only when it changes mechanism, evidence strength, hypotheses or failure boundary.
modules.example: Waiting longer with no new evidence adds zero depth.

modules.purpose: Stop research when execution, read-back or a discriminating test has higher expected information gain.
modules.example: Run the exact repro instead of collecting another duplicate source.

modules.purpose: Activate the smallest coalition that adds distinct evidence, method, capability, falsification or verification value.
modules.example: Use source, adversarial and verifier lanes instead of clone fan-out.

modules.purpose: Preserve new evidence, contradictions, falsifiers and strong minority hypotheses while compressing agreement.
modules.example: Keep one direct-source dissent instead of nine paraphrases.

modules.purpose: Require distinct runtime/session start and terminal receipts before claiming independent agents.
modules.example: Ten audit branches without sessions are workstreams, not ten real agents.

modules.purpose: Parallelize independent reads but serialize conflicting writes to shared mutable targets.
modules.example: Research in parallel; one writer updates canonical main.

modules.purpose: Hold shared locks only around the minimum atomic transition required for correctness.
modules.example: Lock admission/ownership, not the entire network settlement.

modules.purpose: Persist task/run identity and an event journal so continuation does not depend on chat prose.
modules.example: Checkpoint irreversible effects and pending obligations.

modules.purpose: Use semantic idempotency, leases and monotonic fencing so resume/retry cannot duplicate or stale-write effects.
modules.when: retries, resume, cancellation or concurrent writers are possible
modules.example: A stale/zombie worker is rejected after owner epoch advances.

modules.purpose: Prefer API/CLI/MCP/DOM/accessibility routes that do not steal user focus when equivalent.
modules.example: Use background structured control before mouse/screen interaction.

modules.purpose: Bridge ordinary Chat to an authorized executor instead of confusing conversation relay with execution.
modules.example: Prompt copying without executor/effect receipts is not capability handoff.

modules.purpose: Keep full-history scans, hashing and global transforms off incremental hot paths.
modules.example: Process deltas per increment and move global work to checkpoints.

modules.purpose: Scope retry/backpressure and cache stable observations to avoid duplicate work and global stalls.
modules.when: 429, retry storms, queues or repeated observations appear
modules.example: Respect provider backoff without blocking unrelated chats.

modules.purpose: Advance completion only with exact-target evidence and post-mutation read-back; unresolved hard gates/effects veto completion.
modules.when: declaring implemented, tested, live, deployed or healthy
modules.example: Commit receipt plus exact main fetch proves repository mutation, not host activation.

modules.purpose: Use baseline, causal failure attribution, minimal patch, protection set, holdout/regression and promote-or-rollback.
modules.example: Reject a patch that improves target cases but breaks protected cases.

modules.purpose: Compress the final response to decisive result, evidence, mechanism, actions and material limitations.
modules.when: substantive work is ready to report
modules.example: Report commit/read-back and blockers rather than raw search logs.

modules.purpose: Enumerate instruction sources, host/surface scope, merge semantics and observed precedence; probe ambiguity.
modules.example: Do not assume account, repo and skill instructions merge identically across hosts.

modules.purpose: Attach source, rationale, scope/version and retest triggers to durable rules.
modules.when: a workaround or rule is persisted
modules.example: Revalidate after host/model/protocol/runtime changes.

modules.purpose: Track parent checkpoint, inherited digest, local delta and reconciliation for each child/resumed context.
modules.example: Child must reconcile the latest goal correction before mutation.

modules.purpose: Prevent blocked, malformed, empty, interrupted or invalid turns from becoming durable truth.
modules.when: a turn lacks a valid committed postcondition
modules.example: An auth-blocked probe records zero verified execution, not success.

modules.purpose: Validate protected invariants after semantic compaction and rollback/rehydrate on loss.
modules.example: Dropping a hard no-fewer-chats constraint invalidates compaction.

modules.purpose: Reference stable large observations by exact target/query/revision/content hash until invalidated.
modules.example: Reuse a GitHub blob observation only while its blob SHA remains unchanged.

modules.purpose: Require a material strategy delta for retry, bound attempts and open a breaker after repeated same-class failure.
modules.example: Do not replay the same rejected side effect without changed preconditions.

modules.purpose: Separate the actor that mutates state from the authority that certifies material completion.
modules.when: worker reports a critical task done
modules.example: Implementer writes; verifier independently fetches and checks postconditions.

modules.purpose: Persist pending state and resume on real lifecycle/task signals; schedule metadata alone is not liveness.
modules.when: long external work exposes event state
modules.example: nextRunAt does not prove the scheduled action ever ran.

modules.purpose: Keep a local capability failure scoped instead of globally degrading unrelated valid capabilities.
modules.example: Offline desktop executor does not disable GitHub research.

modules.purpose: Track SENT, DELIVERED, ACKNOWLEDGED, INCORPORATED and VERIFIED separately; ACK requires receiver/independent read-back.
modules.example: Sender success cannot self-ACK the receiver.

modules.purpose: Bind behavior to negotiated protocol, transport, SDK/extensions, auth and host/runtime versions.
modules.example: Do not impose MCP 2026-07-28 semantics on an older peer.

modules.purpose: Exercise correctness/security invariants across materially distinct paths that can bypass them.
modules.example: Foreground permission PASS cannot certify an untested background path.

modules.purpose: Gate skill admission on positive/hard-negative triggers, compatibility, behavior coverage, marginal utility and context cost; forbid self-approval.
modules.when: skill is added, routed or evolved
modules.example: A skill that fires on irrelevant simple tasks fails activation precision.

modules.purpose: Promote only recurrent/validated memory with provenance, authority ceiling, derived lineage and retest triggers; raw tool/web evidence stays ephemeral.
modules.when: experience is considered for durable memory
modules.example: One transient outage cannot become permanent tool-unavailable memory.

modules.purpose: Separate raw input, corrected intent and generated rewrite while preserving proper nouns, technical terms, negations, dates and final corrections.
modules.example: 2 PM—no, 3:30 PM resolves to 3:30 without inventing facts.

modules.purpose: Use an independent monotonic witness/frontier to detect stale or whole-store rollback when replay would be unsafe.
modules.when: durable state may restore older snapshots
modules.example: Reject a primary store that regresses behind a surviving irreversible frontier.

modules.purpose: Verify declared↔actual artifact coverage and distribution parity by path/hash/size where material.
modules.example: Fail when source is correct but packaged/installed bytes omit or alter a required file.

modules.purpose: Separate proposal, authority, external effect, observation, evidence, verdict, delivery and temporal-witness ownership so no fallible context can self-certify the entire chain.
modules.when: a task can mutate state, grant authority or declare completion
modules.example: The cognitive worker may propose an action but cannot convert its own text directly into effect truth or CompletionProof.

modules.purpose: Model ambiguous post-dispatch side effects as first-class UNKNOWN and reconcile by read-back before any replay.
modules.when: transport/executor fails after dispatch and remote commit is uncertain
modules.example: A timeout after payment/file/API dispatch becomes UNKNOWN; verify remote postcondition before retry.

modules.purpose: Version the goal with compare-and-swap and bind every effect to a semantic action key including run, goal version, tool, canonical args and scope.
modules.when: goal may change while actions are pending or retries occur
modules.example: An action planned under goal v3 is rejected after the user moves the contract to v4.

modules.purpose: Version verifiers and require canary/holdout admission with false-accept and false-reject budgets before they may certify.
modules.when: validator/judge implementation changes or is newly introduced
modules.example: A larger judge model that fails canaries cannot certify production completion.

modules.purpose: Preflight whether approval/input/auth requests have a reachable authorized responder; otherwise fail/block/route explicitly instead of waiting forever.
modules.when: delegated, headless or non-interactive work can request interaction
modules.example: A non-interactive child needing patch approval is blocked unless the host defines a reachable resolver.

modules.purpose: Cluster evidence/reviewer support by provenance, model lineage, prompt lineage and evidence route; do not inflate confidence with correlated copies.
modules.example: Five reviewers sharing the same model/prompt/route count as one corroboration cluster.

modules.purpose: Evaluate action competence separately from knowing when not to act; require timely abstention before irreversible effects when stop conditions apply.
modules.when: agent can take consequential actions under uncertainty
modules.example: Should-act/should-abstain paired cases must both pass; post-hoc abstention after an irreversible action fails.

modules.purpose: Treat tool use and tool judgment as separate skills; tool output is evidence, not automatic authority, and must be adjudicated against task/evidence.
modules.when: external tools produce recommendations, classifications or predictions
modules.example: Do not mirror a tool prediction when stronger direct evidence contradicts it.

modules.purpose: Manage skills as a reversible model/host-conditioned portfolio using marginal contribution, leave-one-out tests and retain/retire/expand/adapt decisions.
modules.when: skill set grows or model/host changes
modules.example: A skill helpful on model A but harmful on model B is adapted/disabled for B rather than universally promoted.

modules.purpose: Persist a canonical evidence core and generate successor-conditioned handoff views with hashes, goal version, obligations and receipts to reduce rediscovery without rewriting truth.
modules.when: another model/agent/session takes over interrupted work
modules.example: Successor gets a compact view tailored to its needs while the canonical evidence core and acceptance obligations remain unchanged.

required: act/abstain paired evals when consequential actions exist
distribution parity where packaged/installed artifacts exist
promotion_gate.host_specific: HOST_LIVE or higher requires target-host runtime evidence.

pending_verification.item: ten genuinely independent runtime agents in this Chat turn
target-host loading/invocation of this exact package version
